dedupe_keys.name: high ti synthetic inflow dataset for the g1 wind farm control benchmark

description: Technical University of Munich researchers publish synthetic high-turbulence inflow for the G1 wind-farm benchmark. Zenodo supplies time-indexed text velocity fields and mesh coordinates in a ZIP free under CC BY 4.0. SOWFA large-eddy simulations reproduce tunnel spires and roughness elements, sampling a vertical plane 19.1 metres downstream of the inlet. Approximately forty seconds are saved at one-millisecond intervals, with all three velocity components per mesh node. These fields can drive wind-farm control and aeroelastic simulations under reproducible turbulent forcing. Related G6 data-g1-wind-farm-moderate-turbulence-les-inflow covers a different boundary-layer condition. The fields represent a scaled wind tunnel, not a regional weather history. Applying them at another scale requires the documented transformation, and turbulence realism remains model-dependent. No archive was downloaded or flow simulation executed.
